startup.description: Route startup directly into native Continue Save/Load.

enter_title_input_state_immediately.description: Enter the title-input state immediately after required startup loading and splash cleanup, bypassing the post-splash sequence.

return_native_continue_result.description: Return the native Continue result without constructing or displaying the title screen, selecting main-menu state 4 substate 2 through the existing caller.

treat_no_load_completion_as_menu_success.description: Treat the no-load completion as a successful Continue result so startup enters the main menu without loaded save data.

startup.skip_initial_memory_card_check.description: Skip the initial blocking memory-card check while preserving worker and save-data initialization and the later Continue Save/Load flow.

startup.faster_loading.description: Keep sound and stream initialization at boot while loading each RPG or player voice-bank index on its first playback.

initialize_audio_without_voice_indexes.description: Open every native audio archive and initialize sound indexes while preserving the allocated RPG and player voice tables for lazy loading.

load_player_voice_index_before_playback.description: Load and cache the requested player voice-bank index before the resident voice queue starts its clip.

load_rpg_voice_index_before_playback.description: Load and cache the requested RPG voice-bank index before the resident wrapper starts its clip.

startup.loading_screen.description: Replace the boot splashes with a large primitive percentage and progress bar paced across a 6.5-second elapsed-time estimate while the original startup loaders run.

initialize_hold_splash_controller_s_firs.description: Initialize and hold the splash controller's first boot-safe draw slot while preserving the startup loop's real loader checks.

replace_visible_splash_sprite_draw_indep.description: Replace the visible splash sprite draw with independent boot-safe primitives for a percentage and progress bar paced across a 6.5-second elapsed-time estimate.

startup.auto_loading.description: Silently drive the native asynchronous memory-card worker through port-zero scan, record-zero selection, confirmation, and verified load completion before the normal main-menu loader, then report the outcome for ten seconds in the usable main menu.

draw_savedata_outcome_in_main_menu_scree.description: Retain the native main-menu update, temporarily select its frame-wide screen context, draw a non-blocking right-aligned savedata outcome, and restore the prior context.

replace_visible_save_load_controller_upd.description: Replace only Continue's visible Save/Load controller update with the silent first-record state machine while retaining native allocation, cleanup, result handling, and post-load setup.

suppress_visible_save_load_child_draw.description: Replace the Save/Load child draw call with an owned no-op while the silent first-record state machine runs.
